record.nameMeaning: "Tyrant lizard"; the species name rex means 'king' in Latin
record.oneLiner: A giant bipedal carnivorous theropod, among the largest land predators known.
record.description: Tyrannosaurus was a large bipedal carnivore with a massive skull balanced by a long, heavy tail and short but powerful two-clawed forelimbs. It ranged across western North America — then the island continent of Laramidia — at the very end of the Cretaceous, as the apex predator of its environment. Known from several nearly complete skeletons, it is one of the best-represented of all theropods.

notableFacts.text: Its estimated bite force is the largest of any known land animal.
Ranged more widely than any other tyrannosaurid.
Soft tissue and proteins have been reported from at least one specimen.
Most likely both an apex predator and a scavenger.
